CVE-2025-4565.description: Any project that uses Protobuf Pure-Python backend to parse untrusted Protocol Buffers data containing an arbitrary number of recursive groups, recursive messages or a series of SGROUP tags can be corrupted by exceeding the Python recursion limit. This can result in a Denial of service by crashing the application with a RecursionError. We recommend upgrading to version =>6.31.1 or beyond commit 17838beda2943d08b8a9d4df5b68f5f04f26d901

CVE-2026-104635.title: protobuf: protobuf: Denial of Service via deeply nested JSON input
CVE-2026-104635.description: A flaw was found in protobuf. An unauthenticated remote attacker can trigger a Denial of Service (DoS) by submitting a deeply nested JSON document to an application configured to decode self-referential message types. Because the decoder fails to enforce recursion limits on these structures, processing the input exhausts system memory and crashes the application.
